title: Web Summit cancels events as Portugal issues 'state of alert' amid storm warnings (The Irish Times, 10 November 2026)
what_it_says: The Irish Times reports that Web Summit cancelled Wednesday's events as Portugal was placed under a state of alert, the prime minister's recommendation, Web Summit's email to ticket holders and IPMA's warnings. A shadow source for the call-off facts that otherwise rest on websummit.com.
